verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI code-review platform; for example, its codebase scans could plausibly run on a schedule, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows event-triggered automation (automatic reviews on new PRs, comment-triggered reviews, auto-fix, auto-approval) and on-demand codebase scans. Nothing documents cron-like or recurring scheduling of jobs or workflows.
